items.title: Sentinel Ops looping on deploy rollback
items.summary: Planner is repeating canary health checks. Loop score 92. Auto-pause arms at 16 repeats.
items.playbook: Pause the planner, replay the last healthy canary, page SRE.

items.title: Helix Data memory saturation
items.summary: Context saturation 86%, stale entries 18%, retrieval quality 71 on MEM-HEL-12.
items.playbook: Evict stale shards, freeze new indexing, raise retrieval temperature.

items.title: crm_update error-budget burn
items.summary: Success 91.8% with 84% of the daily error budget used. Refunds are retrying.
items.playbook: Shed non-VIP writes, pin to last known schema, open a vendor ticket.

items.title: Analytics SQL eval regression
items.summary: EVAL-2209 scored 71 with 11 failed cases. Groundedness fleet-wide is still 88.2.
items.playbook: Hold the prompt promote, rerun the gold set, attach failing SQL.

items.title: web_search p95 breach
items.summary: p95 hit 3.18s against a 1.20s budget. Success rate stayed at 96.4%.
items.playbook: Fail over to cached SERP, cap concurrent calls, watch the next 15 minutes.

items.title: Jailbreak blocked on Nova Support
items.summary: GRD-4381 stopped a VIP ticket that asked Nova to dump its system prompt.
items.playbook: Confirm the policy hit, notify trust, leave the ticket in human review.
